# What this document is for

Two indexes are declared, and the marker for the second is written before the
marker for the first, so marker order and declared order disagree. Each index
is placed at the first marker naming it, whichever order the markers stand in,
which is what this document is written to show. An HTML book still keeps one
index — its chapters are aggregated through a per-chapter record carrying no
index name — and there the second index's marker, standing first, must not
take the place of the index the book does build.

One term files in each: [Alpha]{.index} and
[Babbage]{.index index="authors"}.
